message.content: Starting the hunt — sampling random traffic to map the space.
Random probing found a clearance violation — now shrinking it to the minimal case.
Shrunk to a single emergency case — verifying it replays before digging in.
Replay confirmed — now inspecting the violation moment to pin down the cause.
Signal flipped to green at step 124 — checking the steps just before to see what was skipped.
Emergency looks like it forces an instant green — gathering the timeline evidence.
Timeline shows the switch cut through yellow — inspecting earlier and testing the no-emergency case.
Cause points to emergency preemption skipping clearance — running a counterfactual without it.
Evidence and counterfactual check out — submitting the final report.
